page.notes: The left-hand strip (facing page 648, with margin notes) is cut off at the scan edge and only fragments are visible; it is not transcribed. Long s was rendered as plain s throughout. Italic is used for the Scripture quotations; the commentary text is roman. The "6." and "7." are margin numbers placed beside the first lines of paragraphs 2 and 3.
